snippet.title: Cauldron Chaos - Exclusive Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up is an alchemy clean-up game enjoyable solo or co-op. Clean up 1000+ ingredients, refine them at multiple processing stations, brew almost 200 unique recipes and place them into correct shelves to transform the laboratory into a place filled with harmony & peace.

Wishlist or buy: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5007680/Cauldron_Chaos_Brew_Potions__Tidy_Up/
